newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - DBS upgrades STIC.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DBS upgrades STIC.

text.p: DBS Investment Research said it had upgraded Singapore Technologies Industrial Corp Ltd (STIC) to an accumulate from a hold following the reorganisation of it and its subsidiaries electronic systems integration businesses.
DBS said in a statement on Tuesday that the reorganisation should boost the company's earnings by Singapore $2.6 million at the pretax level.
"We estimate that earnings per share will grow by about 26 percent for fiscal year 1997 which translates into a price/earnings ratio of 27 times," DBS said.
"Our assessed fair value of 31.5 times puts the stock at a fair price of S$3.76 for fiscal year 1997," DBS added.
On Monday STIC and its subsidiaries ST Computer Systems & Services Ltd and ST Electronic & Engineering Ltd said they were rationalising their electronic systems integration business.
At 0435 GMT STIC shares were trading up 14 cents at S$3.44.
